metadata.title: Thompson indices of knots and the invertibility problem
metadata.abstract: Jones showed that Thompson's group $F$ produces all unoriented links, and introduced its oriented subgroup $\vec{F}$, which produces all oriented links; the same holds for the Brown-Thompson group $F_3$ and its oriented subgroup $\vec{F}_3$. The corresponding Thompson indices measure the complexity of a knot in these groups, much as the braid index does for braid groups. In this article we prove that the span of the Jones polynomial plus $1$ is a lower bound for the $F$- and $\vec{F}$-index, and we give lower bounds for the $\vec{F}$- and $\vec{F}_3$-index in terms of the degrees of the HOMFLY-PT polynomial. We then compute the four indices (the $F$-, $F_3$-, $\vec{F}$- and $\vec{F}_3$-index) for the prime knots with at most 13 crossings, by an exhaustive enumeration of tree diagrams (up to 13 leaves for $F$, 17 for $\vec{F}$, with the HOMFLY-PT polynomials of all the diagrams with 19 leaves, and 9 and 11 for $F_3$ and $\vec{F}_3$) completed by targeted searches; every value is rigorously certified, by exact computations and by verified computations of hyperbolic structures in interval arithmetic. The $F$-index is determined for all knots with at most 11 crossings, the $\vec{F}$-index for all knots with at most 8 crossings, and the $F_3$- and $\vec{F}_3$-index for all knots with at most 12 crossings. The main outcome of these computations is that the oriented indices are sensitive to the orientation: we find hundreds of non-invertible knots $K$ whose reverse $K^r$ has a different $\vec{F}$- or $\vec{F}_3$-index, the smallest being $8_{17}$ (with $\vec{F}_3$-index $7$ and $9$). The $\vec{F}$-index also distinguishes the Conway knot from its mutant, the Kinoshita-Terasaka knot.

analysis.topic: 几何拓扑、低维流形与结
analysis.progressType: 结的 Thompson 指标及其方向敏感性
analysis.workSummary: 用 Jones 多项式的跨度加 1 给 F 和有向 F 指标下界，用 HOMFLY–PT 次数给有向 F 和有向 F₃ 指标下界。通过树图穷举和针对性搜索计算至多 13 交叉素结的多项指标，所得数值由精确计算与区间算术认证。
techniques: Jones 和 HOMFLY–PT 多项式界
树图穷举及针对性搜索
双曲结构的区间算术认证
analysis.breakthrough: 发现数百个结与其反向的有向指标不同。最小例 8₁₇ 的有向 F₃ 指标分别为 7、9。有向 F 指标还区分 Conway 结与其变异结 Kinoshita–Terasaka。
analysis.limitations: 摘要所列完整确定范围分别为 F 指标至 11 交叉、有向 F 至 8 交叉、F₃ 和有向 F₃ 至 12 交叉。至 13 交叉是计算范围，个别已得值的认证须与整体覆盖区分。 当前数学解读依据摘要，尚未逐步审读证明。
analysis.aiEvidence: 第4页致谢和第15页计算方法明确，作者从2022–2023年初版程序出发，用 Claude Code 辅助开发当前代码，扩展到更大树图并提高效率。作者描述了另行认证结果的流程。记计算用途。
analysis.aiEvidenceSource: https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.13208v1 · PDF 第4页 Acknowledgments 与第15页计算方法
